fields.description: DAMAC Riverside's original residential collection comprises four- and five-bedroom townhouses in Dubai Investment Park. Landscaped recreation areas and water-focused community spaces shape its masterplan. This record covers the townhouse development, rather than the later Riverside Views apartment buildings.

overview: The original middle-townhouse plans run over ground and first floors, with a bedroom downstairs and garden-facing living space. The five-bedroom end home adds a second floor with an extra bedroom, maid accommodation and terraces. Its larger saleable total should not be confused with the size of its garden plot.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Dubai Investment Park and the original brochure specifies Dubai Investment Park 2. Its map places Riverside near Emirates Road and Al Yalayis Road. Exact plot access and the registered community description need checking; no unverified location pin has been assigned.
research.priceNote: The original fact sheet starts four-bedroom homes at AED 1.99m and five-bedroom homes at AED 3.18m. A later KMJ selection starts its five-bedroom homes at AED 4.337m. Different release dates and available selections explain why these should not be presented as the same live offer.
research.paymentNote: The original 75/ 25 plan begins with 5%, followed by another 70% through timed instalments and 25% on completion. Later offers may collect 20% upfront instead. The grouped schedule below reproduces the original sale-relative milestones; obtain the actual contract schedule for the selected townhouse.
research.handoverNote: The original launch sheet anticipates December 2027; a later KMJ offer reports Q2 2028. The current contractual programme for each cluster was not established, so the headline date remains unconfirmed.
